title: Update Rootward Square ground and the town's land round it
notes: Direct revised user request 2026-11-03, annotated screenshot: the simple two reskins and blank back lawn are rejected. Build a proper longer shopping strip facing the central promenade/square, extend and move the arrival/loading area, put a small park left of the stairs, allow more shop plots. Remove temporary clockmaker/apothecary placements pending unique imagegen concept review; new models later. Clear all five new shop interiors of loose furniture/stock, retaining structure and saves. Preserve approved camera, boy, lighting fixes and existing square. Edit copied v3 master, preserve v2.

result.summary: Rebuilt the Spindle approach in preserved ground v3: wider landing with moved reciprocal loading points, raised left park, visible long promenade and four future frontages. Temporary twin reskins unplaced, all five shop interiors cleared with room memory/exits preserved. Two original built-in imagegen concept sheets saved; new models/interior assets deferred. Normal build/audit, 57 native gameplay checks and all suite checks pass; review records the documentation-check rerun.
